about_the_game:
Last Mile - is an atmospheric horror game about survival behind the wheel of a car on a night road. You find yourself in a spatial anomaly where every kilometre brings new threats and the road itself turns into a nightmare.

Immersive Experience

The game is played from a first-person perspective in the confined space of a car. An old highway, a gloomy town and a forgotten village, shrouded in darkness and anxiety, await you. Limited resources, rain, fog, squeaky windscreen wipers and frightening shadows outside the window create an atmosphere of helplessness and fear.

Gameplay

Last Mile combines car driving and survival elements in the horror genre:

  • Avoid deadly physical anomalies.

  • Drive away from monsters and be prepared for sudden screamers hiding in the darkness.

  • Keep an eye on your instruments: GPS and headlights will help you stay on the road until your battery runs out.

  • Fight not only terrifying creatures, but also a pursuing car that won't give you a break.

Every decision matters

Should you slow down to examine the shadow ahead, or take a risk and keep going? Should you use your last few percent of battery power or save it for later? Every action can determine whether you survive to the end of the road.

Can you make it through the last mile when the road itself is hunting you?

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-2500 @3.3 GHz / AMD AMD Phenom II X6 1055T
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7870
